title: paul van dyk @ arena
summary: This article describes the diverse crowd at Paul van Dyk's shows at Arena, highlighting the mix of Tresor veterans, friendly gay men, female tourists, models, and even some Berlin locals. It emphasizes that proud magazine will continue to attend his parties.

blocks.markdown:
### paul van dyk @ arena

There may be good reasons not to go to Paule (Paul van Dyk). For example, Ossis (East Germans). But there are also good reasons to go to Paule. For example, wild, young party tourists and rich Russians who, after a short conversation about shared musical taste, let vodka bottles pop. Then there's the horde of models who are visiting Berlin for modeling and have their club visit sponsored by their label.

So here we have a cozy mix of 4000 dance-crazed Tresor veterans, giant friendly gay men, female tourists and models – oh yes, every now and then you even meet someone from Berlin. Furthermore, small groups are more than welcome at the Arena’s door.

Proud magazine will definitely not miss another party by Paule for clearly documented reasons. See you there!

www.paulvandyk.de
